data.title: 夏洛特 · 薰衣草花田的裙摆回眸
data.description: 普罗旺斯起伏如紫色波浪的花田中，微风吹拂。身穿法式碎花裙的夏洛特一手按着草帽，另一手与你十指相扣，回眸浅笑，裙摆在紫色的花海与晴空间飞扬。
data.location: vast rolling lavender field under blue summer sky
data.action: walking through flowers, looking back over shoulder with straw hat held, holding hands, sundress billowing
data.lighting: brilliant summer daylight with soft purple flower reflections
data.mood: idyllic romantic freedom, poetic travel bliss, sun-drenched beauty
data.promptProse: Walking through a sea of blooming lavender in a floral sundress, Charlotte looks back holding hands with an enchanting smile.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte holding hands amidst purple lavender fields under summer sunlight.
